name: Plate XCIV: The Ouroboros
description: The serpent that devours its own tail, drawn after the Chrysopoeia of Cleopatra: ΕΝ ΤΟ ΠΑΝ, the One is the All. Struck in Cauda Pavonis: the peacock's tail, the iridescence that heralds the Stone. “QVOD EST SVPERIVS EST SICVT QVOD INFERIVS”: That which is above is as that which is below.
